predefined_types.description_fr: Chaussée : partie latérale unitaire de la route construite pour la circulation.

predefined_types.description_en: Lateral part of carriageway designated to vehicular traffic for a particular purpose.
predefined_types.description_fr: Voie de circulation : bande de chaussée dédiée à la circulation d'une file de véhicules.

predefined_types.description_en: A lateral part of road adjacent to the carriageway, not intended for vehicular traffic but usable in emergencies.
predefined_types.description_fr: Accotement : partie latérale non destinée à la circulation, utilisable en cas d'urgence.

predefined_types.description_en: A surfaced type of shoulder providing for safe use by vehicles in distress.
predefined_types.description_fr: Bande d'arrêt d'urgence : accotement revêtu pour l'usage des véhicules en difficulté.

predefined_types.description_en: A type of shoulder that is not surfaced.
predefined_types.description_fr: Accotement non revêtu.

predefined_types.description_en: A footpath along the side of a road, normally separated from the vehicular section by a kerb.
predefined_types.description_fr: Trottoir : cheminement piéton le long de la route, séparé de la chaussée par une bordure.

predefined_types.description_en: Lateral road part separating two carriageways of the same road, or traffic lanes and sidewalk.
predefined_types.description_fr: Terre-plein central séparant deux chaussées d'une même route.

predefined_types.description_en: Lateral part of road comprising the carriageway(s), shoulders and medians.
predefined_types.description_fr: Plateforme routière regroupant chaussée(s), accotements et terre-plein.

predefined_types.description_en: A lateral road part located along the road adjoining the outer edges of the shoulders.
predefined_types.description_fr: Abords de route : zone en dehors de la plateforme routière, hors circulation.

predefined_types.description_en: A general concept for various parts of the roadside, e.g. side slopes, roadside ditches, back slopes.
predefined_types.description_fr: Partie latérale de bord de route (talus, fossé, contre-pente...).

predefined_types.description_en: Type of at-grade junction at which traffic streams are directed around a circle.
predefined_types.description_fr: Giratoire (rond-point) : carrefour où la circulation tourne autour d'un îlot central.

predefined_types.description_en: The center of a roundabout, not intended for traffic.
predefined_types.description_fr: Îlot central d'un giratoire.

predefined_types.description_en: A raised platform or guarded area sited in the carriageway to divide traffic streams and provide refuge for pedestrians.
predefined_types.description_fr: Îlot refuge protégeant les piétons au milieu de la chaussée.

predefined_types.description_en: A raised or marked area on the carriageway, typically at a junction, shaped to direct traffic and/or provide pedestrian refuge.
predefined_types.description_fr: Îlot directionnel, généralement à un carrefour, orientant la circulation.

predefined_types.description_en: At-grade junction where two or more roads meet or cross.
predefined_types.description_fr: Carrefour : jonction à niveau où deux routes ou plus se rencontrent.

predefined_types.description_en: At-grade crossing between road and railway.
predefined_types.description_fr: Passage à niveau entre une route et une voie ferrée.

predefined_types.description_en: Designated level crossing over a road for pedestrians.
predefined_types.description_fr: Passage piéton, traversée aménagée pour les piétons.

predefined_types.description_en: Designated level crossing over a road for cyclists.
predefined_types.description_fr: Traversée cyclable aménagée.

predefined_types.description_en: Lateral part of road for parking vehicles.
predefined_types.description_fr: Aire de stationnement en bordure de route.

predefined_types.description_en: Lateral part of road for stopping buses, allowing them to draw out of the traffic lanes.
predefined_types.description_fr: Arrêt de bus, en retrait des voies de circulation.

predefined_types.description_en: A lateral part of a single-lane road that is a widening, allowing one vehicle to move over so another can pass.
predefined_types.description_fr: Aire de croisement, élargissement ponctuel d'une route à voie unique.

predefined_types.description_en: A lateral part of road where vehicles can divert from the ordinary stream of traffic.
predefined_types.description_fr: Aire de repos latérale, où les véhicules peuvent s'écarter de la circulation.

predefined_types.description_en: A part of a road facility where tolls are collected for use of a toll road, tunnel or bridge.
predefined_types.description_fr: Gare de péage où les péages sont collectés.

predefined_types.description_en: A longitudinal, linear segment of a road, defined by uniform characteristics or as a transition segment.
predefined_types.description_fr: Tronçon longitudinal de route, à caractéristiques uniformes ou de transition.

classes.definition_en: A spatial structure element representing a route for the guided passage of wheeled vehicles on rails, supporting the breakdown of a railway project into manageable parts.
classes.definition_fr: Élément de structure spatiale représentant un itinéraire pour le passage guidé de véhicules sur rails, structurant un projet ferroviaire en parties gérables.

predefined_types.description_en: Undefined railway type.
predefined_types.description_fr: Type non précisé.

classes.definition_en: A spatial structure element used to spatially organise a railway line (track, line-side, substructure, above-track), vertically and/or longitudinally.
classes.definition_fr: Élément de structure spatiale organisant une ligne ferroviaire (voie, abords, plateforme, zone caténaire), verticalement et/ou longitudinalement.

predefined_types.description_en: A spatial structure element containing track-related elements, e.g. rails and sleepers.
predefined_types.description_fr: Voie : élément spatial regroupant les éléments de voie (rails, traverses...).

predefined_types.description_en: A spatial structure element further dividing a track; does not contain turnout or dilatation panels.
predefined_types.description_fr: Voie courante : partie de voie sans appareil de voie ni joint de dilatation.

predefined_types.description_en: A spatial structure element further dividing a track; contains turnouts (switches).
predefined_types.description_fr: Zone d'appareil de voie (aiguillage).

predefined_types.description_en: A spatial structure element used at points where expansions or movements of tracks need to be accommodated (e.g. near a bridge).
predefined_types.description_fr: Zone de joint de dilatation de voie, où les mouvements de la voie doivent être absorbés.

predefined_types.description_en: A spatial structure element further dividing a track for purposes not covered by plain/turnout/dilatation track.
predefined_types.description_fr: Partie générique de voie, pour un usage non couvert par les autres catégories.

predefined_types.description_en: A spatial structure element containing elements of the railway not in or over the tracks.
predefined_types.description_fr: Abords de voie : éléments ferroviaires situés en dehors de l'emprise de la voie.

predefined_types.description_en: A spatial structure element further dividing a line-side part into manageable volumes.
predefined_types.description_fr: Partie d'abords de voie, subdivision d'une zone d'abords de voie.

predefined_types.description_en: A spatial structure element containing elements positioned above or over the track, e.g. catenary lines.
predefined_types.description_fr: Zone au-dessus de la voie, contenant les éléments aériens (caténaire...).

predefined_types.description_en: A spatial structure element containing elements positioned below the track, e.g. earthwork platform, subgrade, embankment.
predefined_types.description_fr: Plateforme : infrastructure sous voie (terrassement, plateforme support, remblai).

classes.definition_en: A civil engineering works that allows passage over obstacles (water, valleys, roads, railways) by spanning them, classified per its primary structural typology.
classes.definition_fr: Ouvrage de génie civil permettant le franchissement d'un obstacle (cours d'eau, vallée, route, voie ferrée), classé selon sa typologie structurelle principale.

predefined_types.description_en: A bridge that has one or more arches as its main structure.
predefined_types.description_fr: Pont en arc, dont la structure principale est constituée d'un ou plusieurs arcs.

predefined_types.description_en: A bridge with one or more towers and inclined cables connected to the tower, supporting the deck.
predefined_types.description_fr: Pont à haubans, où le tablier est suspendu par des câbles inclinés reliés à un ou plusieurs pylônes.

predefined_types.description_en: A bridge whose main structural members are catenary cables from which the deck is suspended.
predefined_types.description_fr: Pont suspendu, dont le tablier est suspendu à des câbles porteurs en caténaire.

predefined_types.description_en: A bridge whose main structural members are cantilevers.
predefined_types.description_fr: Pont en encorbellement (cantilever).

predefined_types.description_en: A bridge that uses girders as the means of supporting its deck.
predefined_types.description_fr: Pont à poutres, dont le tablier est supporté par des poutres.

predefined_types.description_en: A bridge with a braced triangulated frame designed to act as a beam.
predefined_types.description_fr: Pont à treillis, structure triangulée contreventée agissant comme une poutre.

predefined_types.description_en: A framework bridge, whose structure is a rigid portal frame.
predefined_types.description_fr: Pont à structure en portique (cadre rigide).

predefined_types.description_en: A transverse drain or waterway construction under a road, railway or canal, or through an embankment.
predefined_types.description_fr: Ponceau ou buse : ouvrage de franchissement transversal sous une route, une voie ferrée ou un remblai.

classes.notes_fr: Les prédéfinis de tablier/pile/culée s'expriment via IfcBridgePart, tandis que les éléments structurels détaillés (poutres, piles, plaques...) restent modélisés avec IfcBeam, IfcColumn, IfcPlate etc., déjà enrichis de PredefinedType spécifiques aux ponts (ex. IfcBeam.PIERCAP, IfcColumn.PIERSTEM).
classes.version_notes: Nouveau en IFC4.3 (extension infrastructure — ouvrages d'art).

classes.definition_en: A spatial structure element used to spatially decompose an IfcBridge into manageable parts (abutment, deck, pier, pylon, sub/superstructure).
classes.definition_fr: Élément de structure spatiale décomposant un IfcBridge en parties gérables (culée, tablier, pile, pylône, infra/superstructure).

predefined_types.description_en: The substructure at the ends of a bridge, supporting its superstructure (wing walls, head wall, stem wall, cone).
predefined_types.description_fr: Culée : appui d'extrémité du pont, supportant la superstructure.

predefined_types.description_en: A structure extending to the ground or into water, supporting the bridge superstructure and transferring loads to the foundation.
predefined_types.description_fr: Pile : appui intermédiaire du pont, transmettant les charges à la fondation.

predefined_types.description_en: A segment of a bridge pier; segments may be separated by construction or expansion joints.
predefined_types.description_fr: Tronçon de pile de pont, séparé par des joints de construction ou de dilatation.

predefined_types.description_en: The bridge deck comprises the elements used for conveying traffic, not performing structural functions of the superstructure.
predefined_types.description_fr: Tablier : partie du pont dédiée à la circulation, sans fonction structurelle propre de superstructure.

predefined_types.description_en: A segment of the bridge deck; segments may be separated by construction or expansion joints.
predefined_types.description_fr: Tronçon de tablier, séparé par des joints de construction ou de dilatation.

predefined_types.description_en: Structural elements that support and anchor the bridge to the ground, transmitting all loads to the supporting strata.
predefined_types.description_fr: Fondation de pont, transmettant les charges au sol porteur.

predefined_types.description_en: A vertical structure supporting cables in suspended or stayed structures.
predefined_types.description_fr: Pylône supportant les câbles d'un pont suspendu ou à haubans.

predefined_types.description_en: The elements that transfer loads to the ground; includes abutments and piers.
predefined_types.description_fr: Infrastructure : ensemble des éléments transmettant les charges au sol (culées, piles).

predefined_types.description_en: The part of the bridge that spans horizontally and transfers the traffic load to the bridge substructures.
predefined_types.description_fr: Superstructure : partie du pont qui franchit l'obstacle et transmet les charges à l'infrastructure.

classes.version_notes: Nouveau en IFC4.3 (extension infrastructure — ouvrages d'art).
